editorial.blurb: Tawakkul brings authentic Hyderabadi soul food to Chicago's Devon Avenue, with standout biryanis and desserts that transport you straight to India.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late—they're surprisingly busy at 11pm, but the Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani and their recommended Fruit Trifle dessert are absolutely worth the wait and any greasiness.
